issues.explanation: The closing sentence says Cao Cao sent Xu Huang and Wang Ping from Xiegu to attack Han Shui. In both source chapters, they are sent from Cao Cao’s camp north of Dingjun Mountain and proceed to Han Shui; Xiegu is only reached much later during Cao Cao’s retreat. This prematurely relocates the army and creates a geographic/timeline inconsistency at the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “从斜谷进攻汉水” with “率军前往汉水” or “从定军山北营前往汉水”。
